comments.body: 2026-11-19 re-triage: ai-proposed - it fails the third test: it changes what a command accepts or does, which is a public interface. Recommend building it; the owner decides the shape.
comments.author: Alexander Terp

creator: Alexander Terp
description: An orchestrator started six helpers and declared `--until-message-from apple,algae,castle,...`; it was refused as one name nobody holds, so it named only the first, and a report from any other helper does not end the wait. Waiting on several helpers is the usual case for an integrator. Accepting a comma-separated list, as `msg post --to` does, or repeating the flag would fit. Adds to a flag's grammar, so ai-proposed. From tooling feedback a_2xu3fNcit.
title: report --until-message-from takes one pane, so an integrator cannot wait on several helpers
